result.summary: Found 2 issues: a major content/text corruption problem and a major layout truncation issue affecting restaurant information display.

issues.description: Text corruption in Tokumaru Ramen Bar section showing '25-35Ⅲdelivery' with invalid Roman numeral character (Ⅲ) instead of 'min', making delivery time information unclear
issues.suggestion: Fix the character encoding or data input validation to ensure proper text rendering. The text should read something like '25-35 min delivery' or similar.

issues.description: Third restaurant card in 'Fastest near you' section (Trattoria Piccol) is cut off on the right side with truncated restaurant name and incomplete information display
issues.suggestion: Adjust card width, padding, or implement proper text truncation with ellipsis to ensure all restaurant names are fully visible or properly abbreviated, especially for horizontal scrolling carousels
